name: Prettier Format on Save
description: Automatically runs Prettier on any file edited by Claude, ensuring consistent code formatting without manual intervention.
author: pascalporedda

name: ESLint Auto-fix
description: Runs ESLint --fix after every PostToolUse file edit, catching linting errors before they accumulate in your codebase.
author: rohitg00

name: Jest Test Runner
description: Executes the relevant Jest test suite whenever Claude modifies a source file, surfacing regressions in real time.
author: disler

name: Git Auto-commit
description: Creates a git commit with a descriptive message after each Claude session stop, giving you a full history of AI-assisted changes.
author: hesreallyhim

name: Branch Protector
description: Intercepts git push commands targeting protected branches and blocks them with a clear error, preventing accidental direct pushes to main.
author: pascalporedda

name: Sound Completion Alert
description: Plays a chime sound when Claude finishes a task, so you can step away and be notified when it's done without watching the terminal.
author: varun86

name: Desktop Notification
description: Sends a native OS desktop notification on Stop and Notification events, keeping you informed without keeping Claude Code in focus.
author: rohitg00

name: Dangerous Command Blocker
description: Blocks destructive shell commands like rm -rf, DROP TABLE, and force-push before they execute, acting as a last line of defence.
author: disler

name: Session Activity Logger
description: Appends a structured JSON log entry for every tool call and session event, giving you a complete audit trail of Claude's actions.
author: hesreallyhim

name: Clipboard Copier
description: Copies Claude's final response to the system clipboard on each Stop event, so you can paste the output immediately without selecting it manually.
author: disler
